paragraphs.text: Before wool can be spun into yarn, it must go through several stages. After shearing, the fleece is spread on a table and the dirtiest parts, usually from the legs and belly, are pulled off by hand. This step is called skirting.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The fleece is then washed in hot water with soap to remove grease and dirt. Too much movement at this stage causes the fibres to lock together, so the wool is left to soak rather than stirred.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Once it is dry, the wool is carded: it is brushed between two surfaces covered in fine wire teeth, which separates the fibres and lines them up in the same direction. The result is a soft, loose sheet or rope of fibre.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Finally, the fibres are spun. A spinning wheel twists them together into a continuous thread, and two or more threads are often twisted together again to make a stronger yarn.
paragraphs.label: D

items.prompt: The dirtiest parts of the fleece are removed by 1 ____

explanation.en: “pulled off by hand” → hand, letter D. C (machine) sounds plausible, but no machine is used at this stage.
explanation.kk: «pulled off by hand» → hand, яғни D әрпі. C (machine) сенімді естіледі, бірақ бұл кезеңде мәтінде машина жоқ.
explanation.ru: «pulled off by hand» → hand, буква D. C (machine) звучит правдоподобно, но в тексте машин на этом этапе нет.

items.quote: washed in hot water with soap
items.prompt: The fleece is washed in hot water with 2 ____

explanation.en: “washed in hot water with soap” → soap, letter A. F (dye) is also used on wool, but the text says nothing about dye.
explanation.kk: «washed in hot water with soap» → soap, яғни A әрпі. F (dye) да жүнге қатысты сұйықтық, бірақ мәтінде бояу туралы ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: «washed in hot water with soap» → soap, буква A. F (dye) — тоже жидкость для шерсти, но в тексте о краске ничего нет.

items.quote: the wool is left to soak rather than stirred
items.prompt: The wool is left to 3 ____ instead of being stirred

explanation.en: “left to soak rather than stirred” → soak, letter E. “Instead of” in the chart = “rather than” in the text.
explanation.kk: «left to soak rather than stirred» → soak, яғни E әрпі. Схемадағы «instead of» = мәтіндегі «rather than».
explanation.ru: «left to soak rather than stirred» → soak, буква E. «Instead of» в схеме = «rather than» в тексте.

items.prompt: Fibres are separated and lined up by 4 ____

explanation.en: “the wool is carded … which separates the fibres and lines them up” → carding, letter G. The text uses the verb “carded”; the box gives the name of the stage.
explanation.kk: «the wool is carded … which separates the fibres and lines them up» → carding, яғни G әрпі. Мәтінде «carded» етістігі, тізімде — кезеңнің атауы.
explanation.ru: «the wool is carded … which separates the fibres and lines them up» → carding, буква G. В тексте глагол «carded», в списке — название этапа.

items.quote: twists them together into a continuous thread
items.prompt: Fibres are twisted into a 5 ____ on a spinning wheel

explanation.en: “twists them together into a continuous thread” → thread, letter B. “Yarn” comes later, from several threads, and is not in the box.
explanation.kk: «twists them together into a continuous thread» → thread, яғни B әрпі. «Yarn» кейін, бірнеше жіптен шығады — ол сөз тізімде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «twists them together into a continuous thread» → thread, буква B. «Yarn» получается позже, из нескольких нитей, — и этого слова в списке нет.
